contains: Pigeonholes climb every wall of the depot, each one stencilled with the name of a world: Ceres, Titan, Kepler Station, places you have only seen as postmarks. The sorting machine hums in the middle of the floor. East, the loading dock door is shut.

Pigeonholes climb every wall of the depot, each one stencilled with the name of a world: Ceres, Titan, Kepler Station, places you have only seen as postmarks. The sorting machine hums in the middle of the floor. East, the loading dock door is shut.
You put on the mail satchel.
The sorting machine is fixed in place.
A squat steel cabinet the size of a shuttle engine, chuckling to itself as it reads addresses. Its out tray is empty for now.
ROUTE 7: Ceres, Titan, Kepler Station. Return to depot when empty.
The loading dock door stays shut until your shift is cleared to launch.
